detail.longDescription: I just learned about HireVue ( https:// en.wikipedia.org/wiki/HireVue ), a platform used by large corporations to screen wage workers. Mercifully I haven't had to do one of these "interviews", which consist of submitting video responses to written questions in real time, along with "games", which entail solving # CAPTCHA -style puzzles in order to guarantee the collected data originates from a human being. It's certainly a logical scheme, forcing the most disadvantaged job seekers to provide free training data, but this should clearly be illegal. It is no different from a prospective # Walmart employee being required to work a couple shifts, unpaid, as part of the "interview". It seems absurd to me that the Wikipedia page lists scandals related to # discrimination but nothing about coercing applicants into performing unpaid labor. # AI # hiring # MachineLearning # USpol # HireView # crime # communism # socialism # anarchy # labor # WageTheft # interview # UnpaidLabor # WhiteCollarCrime
